# `passportsim ble_connect`

Connect the scripted BLE central to an advertiser, or end its connection.

| MCP tool | Scenario step | macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passport_ble_connect` | `ble.connect` | yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim ble_connect [addr] [--disconnect] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--interval <INTERVAL>] [--latency <LATENCY>] [--mtu <MTU>] [--random] [--service <SERVICE>] [--supervision-timeout <SUPERVISION_TIMEOUT>] [--timeout-ms <TIMEOUT_MS>] [--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>] [--within-ms <WITHIN_MS>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `addr` | `<addr>` | `string` | no | Advertiser address, most significant octet first (02:00:00:00:00:01). |
| `disconnect` | `--disconnect` | `boolean` | no | End the connection instead of opening one. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `interval` | `--interval <INTERVAL>` | `integer` | no | Connection_Interval in 1.25 ms units (Core Vol 4 Part E 7.8.12). |
| `latency` | `--latency <LATENCY>` | `integer` | no | Max_Latency in connection events. |
| `mtu` | `--mtu <MTU>` | `integer` | no | Client receive MTU to exchange once connected; 0 exchanges none. |
| `random` | `--random` | `boolean` | no | The address is random (TxAdd). Taken from the scan report when one is known. |
| `service` | `--service <SERVICE>` | `string` | no | Connect to the first connectable advertiser listing this service UUID; `pk` is the Passport Keys vendor service. |
| `supervision_timeout` | `--supervision-timeout <SUPERVISION_TIMEOUT>` | `integer` | no | Supervision_Timeout in 10 ms units. |
| `timeout_ms` | `--timeout-ms <TIMEOUT_MS>` | `integer` | no | Virtual time this call may spend before E_TIMEOUT. |
| `wall_budget_ms` | `--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>` | `integer` | no | Host time this call may spend before E_WALL_BUDGET. |
| `within_ms` | `--within-ms <WITHIN_MS>` | `integer` | no | How long to wait for a connectable advertisement. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

## Errors

`E_USAGE` (1), `E_STATE` (2), `E_TIMEOUT` (4), `E_WALL_BUDGET` (5), `E_LEASE` (6), `E_GUEST_PANIC` (7), `E_DEADLOCK` (8), `E_STUCK` (9), `E_TRIPWIRE` (10), `E_INTERNAL` (17), `E_HLE` (18). What each means: [errors.md](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Connect to the Passport Keys vendor service

```sh
passportsim ble_connect --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "service": "pk"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "service": "pk"
}
'@ | passportsim ble_connect --json -
```

### Connect to an address a scan reported

```sh
passportsim ble_connect --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "addr": "02:00:00:00:00:01"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "addr": "02:00:00:00:00:01"
}
'@ | passportsim ble_connect --json -
```

### End the connection

```sh
passportsim ble_connect --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "disconnect": true
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "disconnect": true
}
'@ | passportsim ble_connect --json -
```
